Build VIHelpeks Project.vi

Owning Palette: VI Helpeks API

The VI builds help files on the basis of the VIHelpeks Project File. A Project file must be preliminary created and configured with VI Helpeks GUI. Information on the built project can be found in the files returned in the Paths indicator.

Details

Click the parameters for details

 

Show Progress Window specifies whether to show progress window during the help generation. Default is TRUE.
VIHelpeks Project File specifies the path to the VI Helpeks Project file (.hgprj) that should be processed to build help files.
Generate HHP specifies whether to generate HHP file (Compiled Help Workshop Project) and the related Index and Content files. Parameters for generation HHP file are configured in the VIHelpeks Project File. Default is TRUE.
Generate CHM specifies whether to generate CHM file (Compiled Help). Parameters for generation CHM file are configured in the HHP project file. Default is TRUE.

IMPORTANT: Microsoft HTML Help Workshop must be installed on the computer in order to generate CHM file.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
dup VIHelpeks Project File returns the same value as VIHelpeks Project File.
Paths returns paths to some important files created during help generation. If any file was not built, its path is empty.
Build Log File indicates the path to HTML file that contains build log.
HHP File indicates the path to the generated HHP file. This path is empty if Generate HHP was specified as FALSE.
CHM File indicates the path to the generated CHM file. This path is empty if Generate CHM was specified as FALSE.
Help Info File indicates the path to Help Info File generated.

Help Info File contains information on the source files, for which help has been built, respective HTML files, and information for linking inside CHM file.
Errors returns number of errors occurred during help generation. Detailed information on errors can be found in the build log file indicated in the Paths.Build Log File.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.

 

Build VIHelpeks Project details

The VI generates set of HTML files. In addition, if allowed, it generates project files for Microsoft HTML Help Workshop (HHP and related files), and compiles CHM file on the base of the HHP and HTML files created.

IMPORTANT: Microsoft HTML Help Workshop must be installed on the computer in order to create CHM files. You can download it at Microsoft website for free: msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ms669985.aspx
